request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

Reject creating an owner whose normalized telephone is already used by any other owner. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
The full test suite is green. There is one test class (`AcceptanceTest`), and both its tests pass with `BUILD SUCCESS`.

## Summary

I implemented rejection of owner creation when the normalized telephone is already used by another owner, returning **409 Conflict**.

Changes:

1. **`rest/advice/DuplicateOwnerTelephoneException.java`** (new) — a `RuntimeException` carrying the offending normalized telephone.

2. **`rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`** — added an `@ExceptionHandler` for `DuplicateOwnerTelephoneException` that returns `HttpStatus.CONFLICT` (409) with a `ProblemDetail` whose `errors` array names `telephone`, matching the existing handler style.

3. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — in `addOwner`, after the existing `normalizeTelephone` step, added `rejectDuplicateTelephone(...)`. It compares the incoming 10-digit normalized value against every existing owner's telephone (each normalized the same way — stripping non-digits — so differing input formats still collide) and throws the new exception on a match.

The duplicate check runs on create only (per the spec, "creating an owner"), after normalization so the comparison is against normalized forms. Both acceptance tests pass: `coreRejectsDuplicateTelephone` (409 on duplicate) and `functionalityAllowsDistinctTelephone` (2xx for distinct numbers).
